rv.q: Circus spin-off lacks the Aardman wit and charm that made Shaun shine
Shuan the Sheep’s Circus Show is enjoyable; very enjoyable.
The synchronisation was always really impressive, and some moments made me wonder how they were even doing them.

cn.t: Critics praise this playful circus adaptation for its impressive physical comedy and fast-paced sketches, though some elements feel unnecessary or overused. The show delivers enjoyable family entertainment overall.
